Part of epic #756. Depends on #726, #731, #732.

Source: forensics report §10.5 + §6 (H5, root-caused) — `docs/reviews/session-mining-2026-07-30.md` (PR #757). Incident: session 96e1d746 (bound sysop) read its own registry line, saw sysop, then passed `--project rawgentic` against the skill's explicit mandate (`skills/pane-handoff/SKILL.md:87`: "`--project` / `--project-path` — the `project` and `project_path` fields of that registry line"); the sysop server-migration work was lost in the misdirection. Reverse precedent: 7a8ba96d — an owner /goal targeting lumenquire landed in a twi-bound session (74 stop-hook fires).

## Description

Make the pane-handoff project binding a hard gate in both directions, so a model judgment call can never silently redirect a lineage.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Outbound: `ad-hoc-handoff` (in `hooks/launcher_lib.py`) refuses a `--project` that differs from the caller's own registry line unless an explicit owner-approved override flag is set, and the skill obtains that approval via AskUserQuestion naming both projects.
2. Inbound: when an arriving /goal's target project differs from the session's registry binding, the session requires explicit confirmation naming both projects before rebinding or arming.
3. Red-before-green test reproducing the H5 shape: bound project A, `--project B` without override → refused with a message naming both.
4. Coordinates with (and does not duplicate) #726 (in-flight work gate), #731 (agent_start failure handling), #732 (advisory-tier prose fix).

## Scope

- In: `hooks/launcher_lib.py` gate + override flag; `skills/pane-handoff/SKILL.md` approval step; inbound /goal-mismatch confirmation guidance.
- Out: goal-content rules (P1); the three prerequisite issues' own scopes.

## Affected components (verified)

- `hooks/launcher_lib.py` (`ad-hoc-handoff`)
- `skills/pane-handoff/SKILL.md:87` (mandate text)

## Risk / size

Low-medium risk (a refusal gate; fail-closed), size M. Complexity: standard.
